instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot from a slightly high angle. In a mossy green forest, a white duvet is spread on the ground. The woman in the blue striped shirt (R1) sits on the left, facing right and looking toward her companion with her right hand raised near her collarbone. The man in the white t-shirt (R2) sits on the right, facing left and looking slightly down with a neutral expression, his left arm resting on the bedding between them. They sit close together on the outdoor bed without touching. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the natural green and white tones.
